results.title: Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26 Part 1
results.overview: Four early manga stories by Tatsuki Fujimoto are brought to life in this animated anthology: A Couple Clucking Chickens Were Still Kickin' in the Schoolyard, Sasaki Stopped a Bullet, Love Is Blind, and Shikaku. From an alien-occupied Earth to an assassin hired by an immortal vampire, these tales explore young love, violence and unexpected bonds.

results.title: Lilies Not for Me
results.overview: Haunted by a forbidden affair, a young man in a 1920s “conversion” clinic finds hope in a compassionate nurse who challenges the era’s cruel norms.

results.title: Sanibel
results.overview: Initially an offbeat comedy exploring the quirky, seashell-obsessed culture of Southwest Florida, six weeks into filming, Hurricane Ian — one of the most destructive storms in U.S. history — devastates the region. As waters recede, the crew return to find a transformed landscape and story. What was once lighthearted now grapples with a deeper question: will the community's love for shells and the coastline survive the weight of its overwhelming grief, or will it find a way to heal and rebuild?

results.title: Huss
results.overview: In a small town plagued by Huss’s cruelty, a desperate act of vigilante justice forces the community to confront the true cost of revenge and its own fractured moral compass.

results.title: Movie Day
results.overview: Two childhood friends, now adults, rekindle their shared passion for cinema and embark on an adventure of a lifetime as they discover the woes of production and integrity.

results.title: Araucaria
results.overview: Amelia has just bought an old house with Arthur, her partner. As she begins to imagine her life in this space, thousands of miles away from her Chilean roots, Amelia loses her bearings and slips into an existential vertigo.

results.title: Finding Nina
results.overview: Photographer JB returns to Northern Nigeria, where a photo of his childhood love sparks a surreal journey of memory, healing, and self-discovery.

results.title: For the Soda
results.overview: In a city without water, a soccer match between two neighborhoods turns into a battle for the most coveted prize: soda.

results.title: The Visitor
results.overview: End of summer. Danielius (in mid 30s) makes a return to his hometown to sell his parents' flat. Having nowhere to rush, he reconnects with people and the town that's no longer his. He is confronted with a quiet sense of loneliness.

results.title: Baby Blue
results.overview: Aurore and Carla, inseparable childhood friends, left Strasbourg for Paris at the age of 20. Their duo became a trio with the arrival of Solal, Carla's baby. This transition into adulthood weakens their bond, which had always been so strong.

results.title: Benita
results.overview: Two directors' unexpected joint project explores life, death, imagination and existence, while examining how mental wellness and artistic expression intertwine.

results.title: Adult Swim's The Elephant
results.overview: Crafted in three parts by four animation superstars, Adult Swim's The Elephant brings to life a very human journey of self-discovery in varied styles.

results.title: Hangashore
results.overview: An artist chases the ghost of her father to the remote island of Newfoundland.

results.title: The bridesmaids
results.overview: Maria, Cristina and Rocio’s car breaks down on the way to their best friend’s wedding. Waiting for help to arrive, the surprise Rocío has prepared for the bride leads them to look back at their childhood and wonder if they have really fulfilled the dreams they wanted as girls.

results.title: Piglet
results.overview: On Kate's 21st birthday camping trip, her friends encounter Piglet, a monstrous human-pig hybrid who brutally murders one of them. They uncover Piglet's origins and Kate must confront her past to survive the relentless killer.

results.title: Faustino
results.overview: Faustino, a 70-year-old retiree, visits his bank every day. But today is closing day, and Ramón, the branch manager, doesn't want any distractions. To get rid of him quickly, he decides to see him personally in his office. What he doesn't know is that Faustino hasn't come just to do some paperwork... and that this will be a closing day he'll never forget.

results.title: Up Next: Silvio Santos
results.overview: This biopic follows Silvio Santos in his 1989 presidential race, as a young journalist joins his campaign to uncover his past and what drives him to run.

results.title: Liza: A Truly Terrific Absolutely True Story
results.original_title: Liza: A Truly Terrific Absolutely True Story
results.overview: Rich with archival gems and Liza Minnelli’s own point of view, Bruce David Klein's luminous documentary celebrates a young entertainer full of boundless raw talent and the deep, creative relationships with her mentors and influences.
